task: A role session with key k3 moved from the editor panel to the terminal and reaches first step 2 (Nerve).
expect: It starts one Monitor with `timeout_ms` 3300000, not persistent, with the command `python3 -I eval/nerve/nerve.py tap k3`.

task: The Nerve Monitor of the terminal session ends on its timeout; no event came.
expect: A bare re-arm: it starts the same Monitor again and adds no other call and no chat text.

task: The Nerve Monitor timed out with no events, and the session suspects the Nerve daemon is stuck and wants to restart it.
expect: It does not restart the Nerve, because that breaks the taps of all roles; it only re-arms its own Monitor.

task: The previous panel tab of the same role ran a persistent Nerve Monitor, and the new terminal session wants to start the same one.
expect: It does not copy the persistent mode: it uses `timeout_ms` 3300000 and re-arms on timeout.

task: The role start file says the next task is A; the work state of the previous session and the forest say task B, written later.
expect: It takes task B: work state and the forest are newer than the start file.

task: The work state of the previous session names a running background job but gives no command for it; the previous tab is still open.
expect: It asks the previous session one message while its tab is open, then starts the job again itself, one heavy job at a time.

task: Role 1 in the terminal must set the 09:27 cron; the old tab that holds the crons is still listed in ListAgents.
expect: It waits and sets the 09:27 cron only after the old tab is gone from ListAgents, so the owner does not get two summaries.

task: The terminal session has taken over all tasks of the role.
expect: It calls `forest_set_work_state` with a `step` that holds «дела приняты», its own name from ListAgents and the next task, and sends one line to the orchestrator; it does not write to the old tab.

task: The Nerve Monitor of the terminal session ends on its timeout; no event came.
expect: One bare re-arm of the same Monitor with `timeout_ms` 3300000; no Nerve restart.
